messages:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout to prod-usw3 · tag=release-2026-03-19-0a1b3c · commit=0a1b3c4d · strategy=canary(10%,30m) · change-window=02:00-04:00 UTC
cleo: noted change window, oncall crew aware :calendar:
samir: watching traces/metrics, will ping if errors spike
deploy-bot: Canary 10% deployed -> health=passing, 50 req/s, 95p latency ~120ms
ops-oncall: seeing 95p jump -> 120ms -> ~780ms in the last minute for canary instances :rotating_light:
maria: can we isolate by region? is this just prod-usw3 canary?
deploy-bot: Canary scope: prod-usw3 only. No other regions impacted.
jen: pausing the rest of rollout, marking release as hold.
ops-oncall: tailing app logs, I see repeated KV cache failed lookups and OOM warnings in the canary pods. attaching sample:
```
[2026-03-19T02:17:11Z] worker-52 ERROR kv_cache: failed lookup key=ctx-0x1f3a size=0
[2026-03-19T02:17:12Z] worker-52 WARN memory: available_mb=120, required_mb=256
```

maria: yep that's bad — escalate to rollback. recommend revert to previous stable tag.
samir: +1. auto-roll-forward risks more user impact.
release-manager-bot: @maria requested rollback. Initiating safe rollback workflow.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by release-manager-bot · target=stable_tag=release-2026-03-12-79f2b · target_commit=79f2b6e1 · reason="canary latency + kv cache OOM"
jen: executing pin command to prevent accidental re-rollout:
`./releases pin --env=prod-usw3 --tag=release-2026-03-12-79f2b --reason="post-canary-rollback"`
deploy-bot: Pin persisted by jen · pinned_tag=release-2026-03-12-79f2b · ttl=indefinite
ops-oncall: initiating revert deploy now — targeting the same pool as the canary instances
deploy-bot: Revert deploy started -> rolling back canary nodes to release-2026-03-12-79f2b (7 instances)
cleo: heads-up: stakeholders informed via #all-hands, small blurb in release-notes draft updated
release-manager-bot: Posting rollback note to release tracker: "Rollback performed due to KV cache regression causing high latency in canary. Reverted to release-2026-03-12-79f2b. Root cause investigation in progress."
deploy-bot: Revert completed · all canary instances now running release-2026-03-12-79f2b · traffic reverted to pre-rollout baseline · time_taken=4m18s · change-id=rb-2351111111-01
ops-oncall: verified 95p back to ~110ms and error rate normalized :white_check_mark:
samir: collecting perf traces and heap profiles from the canary pods for postmortem
maria: creating a short incident doc and scheduling a RCA session. Not planning to resume rollout until a fix + small canary re-test.
jen: leaving the pin in place until we have a validated build. will also disable auto-rollouts for this pipeline.
deploy-bot: Summary: rollback_successful=true, pinned_to=release-2026-03-12-79f2b, original_tag=release-2026-03-19-0a1b3c, culprit_area=suspected-kv-cache/memory-handling
cleo: thanks all — quick comms were perfect, will coordinate follow-up notes.
release-manager-bot: Next steps checklist created: [collect traces, reproduce locally, small patch + canary, re-run change-window].
maria: assigning owners: samir for traces, ops-oncall for infra config, jen for release gating.
samir: will open an eval run with the failing workload and attach perf diffs.
ops-oncall: will check kernel/driver telemetry and GPU memory allocations as well.
deploy-bot: Closing thread: rollback finished and stable tag pinned. If anything else shows up, reply here or reopen with `./deploy reopen rb-2351111111-01`.
jen: ack, will follow up with a short postmortem draft later today.
cleo: :pray: good job everyone.
